item.description:
Release v5.7.0

Changes since v5.6.5

  • docs(MessageList): add performance optimization plan and mark P1 streaming decoupling done
  • feat: add ConversationAgentTurnCount plugin for sub-agent turn indicator
  • feat(AgentTurnRunner): add createTurn, fix resume race, and prefer conversation provider/model
  • feat(AgentTurnRunner): implement turn started notification and parent-child turn tracking
  • feat(Conversation): add parent-child conversation support and propagate through AgentTurnRunner
  • feat(LLMProviderMiniMax): show status bar for Anthropic provider
  • feat(LumiKernel): add createTurn entry point for independent agent turns
  • feat(LumiKernel): add hasTerminalResult and isTerminalToolBatch helpers
  • feat(LumiKernel): add PanelRailTabVisibility to filter rail tabs per view container
  • feat(LumiKernel): add turn started notification and parent-child turn tracking
  • feat(LumiKernel): expose streamingConversationID on MessageStreaming protocol
  • feat(MessageManager): defer persistence of updates via PendingMessageBuffer
  • feat(StoryWriterPlugin): add "Add to Chat" context menu for chapters and mark plugin as beta
  • feat(StoryWriterPlugin): add story writing workspace plugin
  • fix(GitPlugin): cap path length and repository search depth in service layer
  • fix(MessageListPlugin): move bottom breathing room inside anchor to prevent extra scrollable space
  • fix(MessageListPlugin): prevent cross-conversation streaming from rebuilding rows
  • fix(StoryWriterPlugin): fix chapter detail not updating when switching chapters and add agent tools
  • fix(StoryWriterPlugin): localize all user-visible strings and complete translations
  • perf(MarkdownKit): cache block parses on the init path and inline parses via async upgrade
